system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: role="Please remember that you are LightAgent, a useful assistant that helps users use multiple tools.", # system role description
system_prompt_style.note: System prompt built from user-supplied role/instructions; assembly code not in evidence. Memory retrieval may add runtime content.

env_context_strategy.note: General-purpose framework; no repository-context mechanism shown.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Optional durable Sessions, replay, checkpoints, forks, async entry points, scoped Capability Providers, unified Policy, Inbox, Goals, Budgets, Jobs, subagents, context compaction, and SQLite FTS5 retrieval.
context_compaction.note: Compaction mechanism unspecified in evidence; opt-in runtime feature, not default. Closest value chosen.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Opt-in `trace=True` run traces record structured run lifecycle, model request summaries, tool calls, tool results, and errors
observation_format.note: Tool results are Python function string returns (e.g. get_weather returns str).

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: | `LA-JSON` | Tool-call JSON parse failure | Check that tool arguments match the registered schema. |

tool_count.evidence_quote: Supports an unlimited number of customizable tools.
tool_count.note: No default tools; user supplies tools. Builtin python_executor/nos exist but default registration not shown.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: | Tools | `LightAgent(..., tools=[fn])` | Functions should expose `tool_info` metadata. |
edit_primitive.note: No file-editing tool shipped in evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: tool_info dicts hand-written; MCP tools via setup_mcp.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: connects to MCP over stdio and SSE

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: LightFlow chains agents into deterministic multi-step workflows with explicit dependencies, step output passing, retries, checkpointed run records
loop_primitives.note: Default: tool-calling loop (react). LightFlow opt-in; Tree of Thought module opt-in (tree_search closest).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Built-in Tree of Thought (`ToT`) module with reflection, supporting complex task decomposition and multi-step reasoning
planning_granularity.note: ToT off by default; Goals in v0.10 runtime opt-in.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: | Single agent runtime | `LightAgent` | One agent with model calls, tools, memory, streaming, trace, and guardrails. |
multi_agent_topology.note: LightSwarm orchestrator_workers reachable; LightFlow pipeline reachable.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: | Multi-agent routing | `LightSwarm` | Role-based delegation across specialized agents. |
delegation_mechanism.note: Default none; opt-in role_handoff via LightSwarm and subagent Jobs in runtime.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: `HumanApprovalHook`, durable review stores, and LightFlow approval checkpoints support approve, reject, argument editing, human responses, batches, and trace feedback for high-impact actions.
human_in_loop.note: Opt-in; default is no human gating. on_plan approximates LightFlow approval nodes.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: | Basic response | `agent.run(query)` | Returns a string by default. |
short_term_state.note: Structured Session/Goals state opt-in in v0.10 runtime.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Supports custom long-term memory for each user, natively supporting the `mem0` memory module
long_term_memory.note: Memory opt-in (memory=...); Skills via SKILL.md; durable SQLite sessions.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: | Durable session | `agent.run(query, session_id="project-42")` | Continue and replay a persisted conversation. |

self_verification.evidence_quote: LightAgent advances robustness through LLM-powered error detection and self-correction mechanisms

retry_policy.note: Default single run; LightFlow step fixed_n retries opt-in.

termination_condition.note: Budgets in v0.10 runtime may add cost_cap; not detailed.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Optional durable Sessions, replay, checkpoints, forks, async entry points, scoped Capability Providers, unified Policy, Inbox, Goals, Budgets, Jobs
cost_controls.note: Adaptive tool filtering reduces tokens also.

timeouts.note: LightFlow step timeout; LA-408 provider timeouts noted.

execution_isolation.note: Python tools run in-process; python executor uses subprocess.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Tasks and tool calls are completed autonomously without human intervention.
permission_model.note: Opt-in PolicyEngine and guardrails; python executor has dangerous-module blocklist.

tracing.evidence_quote: Structured events, latency, usage, retry/error metrics, JSONL or external export.

replayability.evidence_quote: """Event-sourced sessions, persistence, replay, and context projection."""

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: `LightEvaluator` runs deterministic agent or LightFlow regression cases for output, tool choice, policy events, recovery, latency, usage, and estimated cost.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Reusable input/tool/output guardrail templates help block private data, require confirmation for sensitive tools, validate high-risk parameters, and redact sensitive output.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Lightweight Python framework for OpenAI-compatible agents with tools, memory, guardrails, tracing, lifecycle hooks, multi-agent collaboration, and workflows.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Compatible with OpenAI-style providers such as OpenAI, OpenRouter, Zhipu ChatGLM, Baichuan, StepFun, DeepSeek, Qwen, vLLM, llama.cpp

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: LightAgent v0.10.0 Development: Adds the unified event-sourced Agent Runtime
